item.title: LittleFS vs SPIFFS vs FatFs in 2026: Which Embedded Filesystem Should You Actually Use?
item.description: Your firmware passed every test in the lab. Then a field unit loses power during a config write and comes back with an unreadable flash region — and suddenly your support queue is full of RMAs. On microcontrollers, the filesystem is not a detail you bolt on at the end. It is the component that decides whether a power cut corrupts your users’ data or is a non-event.
